messages:
maya (sec-eng): hey team — user forwarded an email with a zip attachment that they say was from a 'legal@partnercorp.com'. they downloaded and opened it briefly, reporting credential prompt popup. can we triage?
liam (it-support): thanks, maya. user is @jonah, laptop macOS Ventura. we disconnected the machine from network and collected a screenshot.
jonah (backend): yep that was me, popped a Finder alert asking for admin password after opening README.txt inside the zip. i canceled and didn't enter creds.
sandbox-bot: Received sample: 1799001234-attachment.zip — queued for analysis. ETA ~18m.
maya (sec-eng): good containment. liam — can you confirm no corp VPN or token cached on device? also rotate any credentials the user touched (ssh keys, GitHub PAT if used).
liam (it-support): checked: no corp VPN session, but GitHub desktop had a cached token file (~/.config/GitHub/token). i'm pulling it and will rotate now.
jonah (backend): i did have GitHub desktop open but didn't push/pull since earlier. i will revoke PATs and change passwords.
maya (sec-eng): snapshot of email header pasted below:
```
From: "Legal Dept" <legal@partnercorp-email.com>\n
To: jonah@redwood.ai\n
Subject: Urgent: Contract review (zip)\n
Received-SPF: softfail\n
X-Orig-IP: 45.33.12.9\n
```
maya (sec-eng): SPF softfail and weird domain. likely phishing impersonation. sandbox results incoming.
sandbox-bot: Analysis complete for 1799001234-attachment.zip — Indicators: [suspicious-exe-in-zip, persistence-mslaunchd-plist]. Verdict: malicious (dropper). Full report: https://sandbox.internal/reports/1799001234
maya (sec-eng): confirmed malicious. actions: 1) liam — add device to EDR watchlist and run full AV scan + YARA rules. 2) ops-oncall — block IP 45.33.12.9 at perimeter and add domain partnercorp-email.com to denylist. 3) jonah — rotate any tokens, change account passwords, enable 2FA where missing.
liam (it-support): started AV scan; pulled running processes log: `ps aux | grep -i launchd-helper` returned nothing suspicious but i'll run `sudo mdfind` for recently modified items. added to EDR quarantine rule.
ops-oncall: firewall rule pushed to block 45.33.12.9 and related CIDR. domain denylist staged across cloud proxy.
maya (sec-eng): good. i'll open an incident record (INC-2026-042) and prepare user comms + company-wide awareness blurb. recommend urgent phishing digest and a note to not open zip attachments unless from matched contact.
jonah (backend): thanks all — sorry for the hassle. i didn't paste any prompts or credentials anywhere.
maya (sec-eng): copy — we'll follow up with a short post-incident email and schedule a 15m runbook review next week. tagging remediation checklist: revoke tokens, EDR sweep, firewall block, sandbox IOC ingestion, user training nudge.
liam (it-support): scan complete — found one quarantined binary under `/tmp/.X12tmp/launchhelper` — hash: `d4b5f3a9c8e2a1f7`. submitting to MTS for IOC sharing.
maya (sec-eng): added hash to IOC list and to our SIEM correlation. closing thread when postmortem note is published. :white_check_mark:
